item.title: 2026-11-22 No.001 Buy less, buy better
item.description: The common grammar of appliances in 2026: units fall, prices rise. Big appliances are defending margins, small appliances are going premium and single-household, and AI ties the two together. Today's picks: Shinil Eco Fan Cube Heater SEH-H800V, Zojirushi STAN Humidifier EE-FAH50K, Blaupunkt Air Easy Pro BLP-HD7300, Plaud Note Pro AI Voice Recorder, Plaud NotePin S AI Voice Recorder
